question: Let \(a\) and \(b\) be any two nonzero real numbers. Then the number of complex numbers \(z\) satisfying the equation \(|z|^2+a|z|+b=0\) is

options.A: 0 or 2 and both these values are possible
options.B: 0 or 4 and both these values are possible
options.C: 0, 2 or 4 and all these values are possible
options.D: 0 or infinitely many and both these values are possible

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
